answer: The relic schedule is applied in cipher and crystal publishes each instalment. A payout is split and thus 46% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker hence cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4215 identities would post 4965 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
